blockers.reason: Remote product Git/auth APIs are absent; local fixture loading is not a remote clone.
Designer is a global tool; independent document designer sessions and automatic switching are absent.

Production Studio launches independent applications, but Hot Reload of one instance leaves its source read-only while another instance of the same project is live: DocumentLocks retains the other session's lock. The browser adapter records this observed blocker without unlocking the editor or stopping the duplicate; the full multi-app conjunction remains unqualified.
Cross-app resource admission and independent network grant revocation are absent; component concurrency is narrower.
No physical adapter qualification is retained. Browser backend records and deliberate device destruction cannot establish physical hardware coverage.
The requested browser WebGPU backend or a real device was unavailable; fallback is not a GPU pass.
Runtime-only two-app publishing/download APIs are absent; IDE standalone packaging is not application export.
Controlled-provider PAT/OAuth/device-flow/logout/non-fast-forward qualification is blocked by absent product APIs and unprovided account authorization.
An exact source archive, SHA-256 and trusted matching release build report must be supplied before archive qualification.
Windows/Linux/macOS, Firefox/WebKit, physical DPI/mobile and supported physical GPUs remain unqualified until retained captures exist.
